next:wr:840.hint: 私たちは空港に2時間早く着いた
next:wr:840.answer: We arrived at the airport two hours early.
next:wr:840.fullSentence: We arrived at the airport two hours early.
next:wr:840.explanation: arrive at/in ~ ＝ get to ~ ＝ reach ~(reachは他動詞で前置詞不要)。
next:wr:840.relatedInfo: 狭い場所にはat、広い場所にはinを使う。

next:wr:842.answer: The sun rises in the east.
next:wr:842.fullSentence: The sun rises in the east.
next:wr:842.explanation: rise-rose-risen(自動詞)『上がる』。他動詞raiseとの語形・意味の対比。
next:wr:842.relatedInfo: raiseは目的語を必要とする他動詞。

next:wr:844.hint: 猫は一日中ソファに横たわっていた
next:wr:844.answer: The cat lay on the sofa all day.
next:wr:844.fullSentence: The cat lay on the sofa all day.
next:wr:844.explanation: lie-lay-lain(自動詞)『横たわる』の過去形。他動詞layとの語形・意味の対比。
next:wr:844.relatedInfo: lay(横たえる)の原形と紛らわしい点に注意。

next:wr:846.hint: お願いを聞いてもらえますか
next:wr:846.answer: Will you do me a favor?
next:wr:846.fullSentence: Will you do me a favor?
next:wr:846.explanation: do A B ＝ do B for A『AにBをしてやる』。favorは『頼み事』の意味。
next:wr:846.relatedInfo: ＝May I ask a favor of you?

next:wr:848.hint: この近道で多くの時間を節約できる
next:wr:848.answer: This shortcut will save us a lot of time.
next:wr:848.fullSentence: This shortcut will save us a lot of time.
next:wr:848.relatedInfo: save A the trouble of doingで『〜する手間を省く』。

next:wr:850.hint: レポートを終えるのに3時間かかった
next:wr:850.answer: It took me three hours to finish the report.
next:wr:850.fullSentence: It took me three hours to finish the report.
next:wr:850.explanation: take AB『AにBの時間がかかる』(It takes A B to do)。
next:wr:850.relatedInfo: costとtakeの語順パターンが似ている。

next:wr:852.hint: お金を少し貸してもらえますか
next:wr:852.answer: Could you lend me some money?
next:wr:852.fullSentence: Could you lend me some money?
next:wr:852.relatedInfo: borrow(借りる)との混同に注意。

next:wr:854.hint: 彼女はその計画について私に何も言わなかった
next:wr:854.answer: She said nothing to me about the plan.
next:wr:854.fullSentence: She said nothing to me about the plan.
next:wr:854.explanation: sayはSVOO不可(×say me nothing)。say B to Aの形をとる点でtellと対比。
next:wr:854.relatedInfo: tell(SVOO可)との違いを整理する。

next:wr:856.hint: 彼はチームに支援を約束した
next:wr:856.answer: He promised his support to the team.
next:wr:856.fullSentence: He promised his support to the team.
next:wr:856.explanation: promise A B ＝ promise B to A(toを使うグループ)。
next:wr:856.relatedInfo: buy/read/sendも同様の書き換えパターンを持つ。

next:wr:858.hint: 貧困は彼から学ぶ機会を奪った
next:wr:858.answer: Poverty deprived him of the chance to study.
next:wr:858.fullSentence: Poverty deprived him of the chance to study.
next:wr:858.explanation: deprive A of B『AからBを奪う』。
next:wr:858.relatedInfo: rob, cure, clear, ridも同じof構文をとる。

next:wr:860.hint: その薬は彼女の病気を治した
next:wr:860.answer: The medicine cured her of her illness.
next:wr:860.fullSentence: The medicine cured her of her illness.
next:wr:860.explanation: cure A of B『AのBを治す』。

next:wr:862.hint: その療法は彼のストレスを軽減するのに役立った
next:wr:862.answer: The therapy helped relieve him of his stress.
next:wr:862.fullSentence: The therapy helped relieve him of his stress.
next:wr:862.explanation: relieve A of B『AからBを取り除く、軽減する』。

next:wr:864.hint: 何も彼女が夢を叶えるのを止められなかった
next:wr:864.answer: Nothing could stop her from achieving her dream.
next:wr:864.fullSentence: Nothing could stop her from achieving her dream.
next:wr:864.explanation: stop A from doing『Aが〜するのを止める』。
next:wr:864.relatedInfo: prevent A from doingと同じ構文。

next:wr:866.hint: 高いコストが彼に起業をためらわせた
next:wr:866.answer: High costs discouraged him from starting the business.
next:wr:866.fullSentence: High costs discouraged him from starting the business.
next:wr:866.explanation: discourage A from doing『Aに〜する気をなくさせる』。
next:wr:866.relatedInfo: encourage A to do(させる気にさせる)の反対。

next:wr:868.hint: このバージョンを元のものと比較してください
next:wr:868.answer: Please compare this version with the original.
next:wr:868.fullSentence: Please compare this version with the original.
next:wr:868.explanation: compare A with B『AとBを比較する』。
next:wr:868.relatedInfo: compare A to B(たとえる)との違いに注意。

next:wr:870.hint: 彼らは彼女に花束を贈呈した
next:wr:870.answer: They presented her with a bouquet of flowers.
next:wr:870.fullSentence: They presented her with a bouquet of flowers.
next:wr:870.explanation: present A with B『AにBを贈呈する』。

next:wr:872.hint: 変更があればすぐに私に知らせてください
next:wr:872.answer: Please inform me of any changes immediately.
next:wr:872.fullSentence: Please inform me of any changes immediately.
next:wr:872.explanation: inform A of B『AにBを知らせる』。
next:wr:872.relatedInfo: informはSVOOをとらない点に注意。

next:wr:874.hint: 警察は彼にその犯罪の疑いをかけた
next:wr:874.answer: Police suspected him of the crime.
next:wr:874.fullSentence: Police suspected him of the crime.
next:wr:874.explanation: suspect A of B『AにBの疑いをかける』。
next:wr:874.relatedInfo: accuse A of Bとも似た構文。

next:wr:876.hint: そのミスのことで彼を責めないで
next:wr:876.answer: Don't blame him for the mistake.
next:wr:876.fullSentence: Don't blame him for the mistake.
next:wr:876.explanation: blame A for B『BのことでAを責める』。

next:wr:878.hint: 彼女は彼が遅刻したことを批判した
next:wr:878.answer: She criticized him for being late.
next:wr:878.fullSentence: She criticized him for being late.
next:wr:878.explanation: criticize A for B『BのことでAを批判する』。
next:wr:878.relatedInfo: blame A for Bと同じfor構文。

next:wr:880.hint: あなたの助けにとても感謝しています
next:wr:880.answer: I am very grateful to you for your help.
next:wr:880.fullSentence: I am very grateful to you for your help.
next:wr:880.explanation: be grateful/thankful/obliged to A for B『Aに(Bのことで)感謝している』。
next:wr:880.relatedInfo: thank A for Bとほぼ同じ内容。

next:wr:882.hint: このドレスは本当にあなたに似合う
next:wr:882.explanation: suit=人の雰囲気・好みに合う。fit(サイズが合う)との使い分けに注意。
next:wr:882.relatedInfo: 洋服・色などが『似合う』ことを表す。

next:wr:884.hint: このネクタイはあなたのシャツに完璧に合う
next:wr:884.answer: This tie matches your shirt perfectly.
next:wr:884.fullSentence: This tie matches your shirt perfectly.
next:wr:884.relatedInfo: go with(物が合う)とほぼ同義。

next:wr:886.hint: 彼がパーティーに来るとは思えない
next:wr:886.answer: I doubt that he will come to the party.
next:wr:886.fullSentence: I doubt that he will come to the party.
next:wr:886.explanation: doubt that S+V『〜ではないと思う』(doubtは否定的なニュアンスを内包する)。
next:wr:886.relatedInfo: suspectとの意味の対比に注意。

next:wr:888.hint: 彼の成功は両親の支えのおかげだ
next:wr:888.answer: He owes his success to his parents' support.
next:wr:888.fullSentence: He owes his success to his parents' support.
next:wr:888.explanation: owe A to B『AはBのおかげだ』。
next:wr:888.relatedInfo: owe what he is to B(今の彼はBのおかげ)とも関連。
